meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 引导你完成创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体的全过程：确认你的频道身份、把私信消息组接到新智能体上，并让智能体按正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行，你准备为某个私信频道（如 Discord、Telegram 等）创建第一个智能体时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Discord 创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成频道选择、身份确认和欢迎私信验证。

say.text: 为我的 Telegram 配置一个新的 DM 智能体
say.note: 它会询问你的用户 ID 和显示名，然后启动初始化脚本。

say.text: 我要接收新智能体的欢迎私信，开始配置吧
say.note: 触发完整流程，最终你会收到一条来自该智能体的私信。

howto.what_en: Guide you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: resolve your channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to the new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: Triggered after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want to create the first agent for a DM channel such as Discord or Telegram.

say_en.text: Help me create the first NanoClaw agent for Discord
Set up a new DM agent for my Telegram
say_en.note: It asks for your user ID and display name, then runs the init script.

say_en.text: I'd like to receive the welcome DM from the new agent; let's start
say_en.note: Runs the full flow and you get a private message from the agent.
